# extend explain to support python3

Fix the `explain` helper ([#8](DOT-8.md)) on a machine without a `python` binary:

```
$ explain git rebase -i HEAD~20                         
explain:2: command not found: python
```

The helper of the time shelled out to `python` (to URL-encode the command); macOS 12.3 removed the `python` symlink to Python 2, leaving only `python3`.
